scenes.narration: Ravi woke up on an ordinary Tuesday, completely unaware that his whole life was about to change before lunch.
On the kitchen table sat a plain envelope with no return address, and inside it was a single typed sentence that made no sense at all.
scenes.subtitle: A strange letter. No sender. One sentence.

scenes.narration: By the time he reached the bank, a line of reporters was already waiting outside, and none of them would say why.
